newsitem.title: UK: UK's EMAP names Tony Tillin to the board.
newsitem.headline: UK's EMAP names Tony Tillin to the board.

text.p: British publishing group, EMAP Plc on Friday said it named Tony Tillin, chief executive of the group's Business Communciations Division, to the board.
Tillin, 50, joined EMAP last May. He was previously chief executive of the Reed Travel Group at Reed Elsevier .
